snippet.title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms III 3: Dragon of Destiny Trailer
snippet.description: This is a trailer I made with various portions of gameplay from Romance of the Three Kingdoms III: Dragon of Destiny on SNES. I plan to make one for each RTK game except RTK V.
